label: lem:interval_integrable_restriction
title: Interval integrability restriction
statement: If $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,b]$ and $x \in (\min(a,b), \max(a,b))$, then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,x]$. This follows from \texttt{IntervalIntegrable.mono\_set} since $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; x \subseteq \texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b$.
proof: The interval $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; x$ is contained in $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b$, so integrability restricts by \texttt{IntervalIntegrable.mono\_set}.
